text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hassan meets Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan bin Abdul-Aziz.
- Parliament considers measures to help victims of floods.
- The Moroccan population will reach 43 million in 2040.
- Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj says the government had taken measures to ensure credibility of bank checks.
- Farming land is flooded, four bridges and 43 houses damaged following heavy rains in several Moroccan regions.
